_mod_info: VC firms that can offer your company funding. Each has industry preferences and a prestige tier that affects deal quality and difficulty. Only 'name' is required.

_format.name: Firm name (required)
_format.tier: One of: elite, top, mid, emerging (controls check size and prestige)
_format.preferred_focus: Array of preferred industries: saas, consumer, marketplace, dev_tools (optional — empty means generalist)
_format.style: Short flavor text about the firm's reputation (optional)
_format.check_min: Minimum investment amount in dollars (optional, derived from tier if missing)
_format.check_max: Maximum investment amount in dollars (optional, derived from tier if missing)

firms.name: Sequoya Capital
firms.style: Legendary firm. They funded half of Silicon Valley. Getting a meeting is the hard part.

firms.name: Z Combinator
firms.style: The startup factory. Their batch network is worth more than the check.

firms.name: Andersen Horwitz
firms.style: Massive platform firm. They'll assign you a dedicated ops team and 47 Slack channels.

firms.name: Benchmrk
firms.style: Small partnership, legendary picks. They only do a few deals a year.

firms.name: Foundrs Fund
firms.style: Contrarian bets on hard tech. They want founders who think different.

firms.name: Accl Partners
firms.style: Early-stage SaaS is their bread and butter. They've seen every B2B pitch.

firms.name: Litespeed Venture
firms.style: Growth-stage specialists. They move fast when they see traction.

firms.name: Greylok Partners
firms.style: Enterprise focus. Their partners are ex-operators who actually read your metrics.

firms.name: Generl Catalyst
firms.style: Stage-agnostic generalists. They'll lead your seed or your Series D.

firms.name: Kleiner Perkns
firms.style: Legacy firm reinventing themselves. Still have deep networks.

firms.name: Indx Ventures
firms.style: European roots, global reach. They love marketplaces and network effects.

firms.name: Tigr Global
firms.style: Aggressive crossover fund. They write big checks fast and don't ask for board seats.

firms.name: SoftBnk Vision
firms.style: Mega-fund energy. They'll either 10x your round or ghost you completely.

firms.name: Bessemr Venture
firms.style: SaaS metrics nerds. They have a public spreadsheet ranking every cloud company.

firms.name: Khoslo Ventures
firms.style: Deep tech focus. They want to see real innovation, not another wrapper.

firms.name: Insyte Partners
firms.style: Growth equity firm. They come in late but bring serious operational support.

firms.name: NEO Associates
firms.style: One of the largest VC firms by AUM. Diversified across every sector.

firms.name: Redpoynt
firms.style: Consistent performers. Not flashy, but their portfolio companies rarely die.

firms.name: Ribbt Capital
firms.style: Fintech obsessed. If your product touches money, they want to talk.

firms.name: First Rnd Capital
firms.style: Pre-seed and seed specialists. They help with hiring your first 10 people.

firms.name: Craft Venures
firms.style: Consumer-focused seed fund. They have strong opinions about product design.

firms.name: Floodgait
firms.style: Micro-fund that punches above its weight. Quick decisions, no BS.

firms.name: Initializ Capital
firms.style: Technical founders backing technical founders. They'll review your architecture.

firms.name: Boldstart VC
firms.style: Developer-first investing. They know the dev tools market cold.
